name: OpenAI Codex
description: Installs the OpenAI Codex CLI, mounts host Codex configuration and authentication, and installs the Codex VS Code extension.

instructionFilePath.description: Path to the central AGENTS.md file, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/AGENTS.md') to link it as the workspace AGENTS.md. An existing AGENTS.md is preserved.

rulesPath.description: Path to the Codex rules directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set to a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/rules') to link it to .codex/rules.

skillsPath.description: Path to the skills directory, relative to the workspace root. Default is empty (disabled). Set a path (e.g. 'docs/agents/skills') to link it into .agents/skills. An existing .agents/skills directory or link is preserved.
